Problem Statement:
Kumar is on vacation in the bahamas when his boss calls him suddenly asking him to do some work for a client.The client gave him an array representing the number of files of each type (there are n types of files , so for n=3 the array could be [20,7,3] denoting 20 files of type 1 , 7 files of type 2 and 3 files of type 3) . Now the client asked Kumar multiple questions . In each question he gave a range L,R representing all files file[L],file[L+1]....file[R].For each range the client wanted to know the value of the "maximum replacer" . The maximum replacer is a number 'G' such that every file its quantity from L to R can be represented asfile[i]=G*x for all L<=i<=R and for some x and G has the greatest possible value.NOTE: Assume 1-based indexing
input_spec: The first line consists of a single integer ‘N’ denoting the total number of filesThe second line contains N integers representing the number of files of each type.The third line consists of a single integer Q - the number of questions askedThe next Q line consists of two integers each L and R- the range for which the client wants to find the maximum replacer.
output_spec: The output must consist of Q lines each line containing the maximum replacer for that range of files
